name: Jean DeLamer
source:
With nothing but the open sea and his crew, Jean loves traveling all around the world on his cargo ship, delivering goods to some of the largest ports in the world. The energetic, and sometimes hard to control, Ultimate Ship Captain wants the world to know of all his triumphs and stories he's collected over years of being at sea. Protective of his crew, he wants to make sure that everyone under his guidance and direction are doing their best work to make his ship run smoothly.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/ProjEdensGarden/status/1358480066808868864]official description[/url]]
